name: Battlefield Caller (Warmage Archetype)
body:
Some warmages focus their leaning upon calling, summoning, and creating their weapons. These are called the battlefield callers.

Summoning Magics (Ex)

A battlefield caller adds all conjuration spells available to a sorcerer or wizard to their spell list but loses access to evocation spells. This ability modifies spells.

Arcane Strategies (Ex)

A battlefield caller gains access to the following arcane discoveries:

Alacritous Summoning (Ex)

You can cast any conjuration spell with a casting time of 1 round as a standard action. However, doing so halves the duration of the spell (minimum 1 round).

Battle Magics (Ex)

You add an evocation spell available to the wizard to each spell level you possess or later gain, including cantrips, of your spell list. The spell must still be learned and added to your spellbook before it can be used. This arcane strategy can be selected multiple times, gaining new spells for each level.

Ignore Protections (Ex)

Your summoned creatures ignore the protections of your enemies. Any spell or ability that would prevent the summoned or called creature from attacking an enemy by their nature as summoned creatures, such as protection from evil, are ignored by them. The rest of the benefits of those spells, like the AC bonus of protection from evil are not ignored.

Summon Multitudes (Ex)

When summoning creatures, you can summon a larger force. Whenever you cast a summon monster spell, you can summon two creatures from a single list 1 or more levels lower than the level of the spell. The two creatures must have alignments that are opposite along at least one axis (chaotic and lawful or evil and good).

For example, if you cast summon monster III, you could summon a celestial wolf and a fiendish hyena from the 2nd-level list.

Tenacious Summons (Ex)

Your summoned creatures more easily defend against abilities to send them away.

Your summoned or called creatures gain a bonus on saving throws against abilities or spells that attempt to send them back to their home plane equal to 1/2 your warmage class level. The bonus is also applied to the DC to dispel them.

Sudden Extend (Ex)

At 6th level, a battlefield caller gains Sudden Metamagic for Extend Spell as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. This ability replaces sudden empower.

Rejuvenate Summon (Su)

At 18th level, a battlefield caller gains the ability to keep a summoned creature going with their magic. As a swift action, a battlefield caller can expend a conjuration spell of the same spell level or higher than the summoned creature to restart the summon’s duration, fully heal them, and remove any conditions as if the summon spell was just cast.

This ability replaces sudden maximize.

Summoner Incarnate (Ex)

At 20th level, a warmage has reached the pinnacle of summoning magic. A warmage gains one additional cantrip and one additional slot of each other spell level, all of which must be used to prepare conjuration spells.

Additionally, their base attack bonus increases by 5 for attack rolls they make with their spells. This ability replaces war incarnate.
